offers.name: Agent Reliability & Evidence Audit
offers.description: Human-adjudicated evaluation of one authorized AI agent or MCP workflow, up to 25 approved cases, reporting source attribution, action/outcome status, numerical evidence and regression risk.
offers.deliverable: Human-reviewed source-linked report, reproducible issues, remediation recommendations and a bounded follow-up rerun after approved payment and separate fulfillment
acceptance_criteria: Every substantive finding links to reproducible source evidence
Distinguish literal/format compliance from independently adjudicated factual correctness
Never execute unapproved production agents, copy secrets, or reuse client data for training
No order is marked paid without exact matching signed Stripe event
No paid report is released before manual reviewer approval
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.

offers.name: Agent-Ready Interface Assessment
offers.description: Provide authorized business workflow/API scope and target agent clients
offers.deliverable: Return MCP/WebMCP/REST interface specification and security checklist
acceptance_criteria: No unauthorized modifications; bounded tool permissions
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.

offers.name: Code Risk Review
offers.description: Provide authorized repository snapshot and audit scope
offers.deliverable: Return code-anchored findings, severity and suggested tests
acceptance_criteria: Ground findings in code; no secret collection or automatic production changes
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.

offers.name: Data Discrepancy Report
offers.description: Provide two authorized datasets, join keys and expected reconciliation rules
offers.deliverable: Return audited discrepancies, unmatched rows and checks
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible count reconciliation; no fabricated matching
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.

offers.name: Private AI Feasibility Report
offers.description: Provide workload, privacy, budget and infrastructure constraints
offers.deliverable: Return options, assumptions, tradeoffs and benchmark plan
acceptance_criteria: Evidence-backed hardware and model assumptions; explicit unknowns
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.

offers.name: Competitor Change Brief
offers.description: Provide authorized competitor URLs or data snapshots and comparison window
offers.deliverable: Return timestamped change log, anomalies and evidence links
acceptance_criteria: Separate observed events from inference; no disappearance-equals-sale claims
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.

offers.name: Talent Market Map
offers.description: Provide role profile, must-have skills, geography and constraints
offers.deliverable: Return skills landscape and reproducible sourcing map
acceptance_criteria: Public or authorized sources; no invented contact information
offers.privacy: No confidential records in public intake; approved data only via separate secure workflow.
